О проекте

Rosewood Residences Kamala is a branded villa community on Kamala Bay on Phuket's west coast, announced in January 2022 by Rosewood Hotels & Resorts and developer Raimon Land. The announcement described 14 standalone villas of 4 to 6 bedrooms, each with a private pool and sea views, in a gated community with round-the-clock Rosewood service.

Planned shared facilities are a restaurant and bar, a private residents' area and a tennis court. It was billed as Rosewood's first standalone residential project in Asia Pacific, so it is a branded-residence product rather than a conventional villa estate.

The 2022 announcement targeted an opening in 2024. Later press reports describe a changed scale and launch timing, and we found no confirmed construction or handover status. Prices, villa count, ownership structure and availability are therefore not stated here: ask us on WhatsApp and we will check the current position with the developer.
